name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
description: Support scheme for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 trades.
benefits: Skill training, toolkit incentive up to ₹15,000, collateral-free loans up to ₹3 lakh at concessional interest.
eligibility: Artisan/craftsperson working with hands and tools, engaged in one of 18 specified trades.

name: MUDRA Loan Scheme (Shishu/Kishor/Tarun)
description: Micro-finance scheme providing loans to small/micro business owners including artisans.
benefits: Loans from ₹50,000 up to ₹10 lakh without collateral, depending on business stage.
eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises including artisans and craft businesses.

name: National Handicrafts Development Programme (NHDP)
description: Comprehensive scheme for holistic development of handicrafts sector artisans.
benefits: Design and technology upgradation, marketing support, financial assistance for infrastructure.
eligibility: Registered artisans/artisan groups engaged in handicraft production.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Bank loans for women and SC/ST entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for setting up new enterprises.
eligibility: Women entrepreneurs or SC/ST entrepreneurs above 18 years, for new (greenfield) enterprises.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Shilpi Swasthya Bima Yojana
description: Health insurance scheme for artisans and their families.
benefits: Health insurance coverage up to ₹2 lakh per family per year.
eligibility: Artisans registered under the handicraft sector with valid artisan card.
